name: Mofuku Rinkan Hitozuma Nikubenki ~Jutai~
original_name: 喪服輪姦人妻肉便器～受胎～
source:
A man appears at her husband's wake. She is forced to pay back the debt that her husband had left behind by having sex with the man, and others.
